# Robot Framework Professional — Screenshot Plan

## Screenshots

### 1. Code Completion
**Title:** Intelligent keyword and variable completion
**Capture:** A .robot file with the code completion popup showing keyword suggestions from BuiltIn, SeleniumLibrary, and custom keywords with documentation preview.

### 2. Syntax Highlighting
**Title:** Full syntax highlighting for Robot Framework
**Capture:** A complete .robot file showing colored sections (Settings, Test Cases, Keywords), highlighted variables, and keyword arguments.

### 3. Step-Through Debugger
**Title:** Debug Robot Framework tests with breakpoints
**Capture:** The debugger view with a breakpoint hit in a test case, the variables panel showing current values, and the call stack showing keyword nesting.

### 4. Interactive REPL
**Title:** Test keywords in real time
**Capture:** The REPL tool window with a few executed keywords showing their output, demonstrating real-time keyword testing without running a full suite.

### 5. Web Inspector
**Title:** Visual element selection for Selenium tests
**Capture:** The Web Inspector tool window showing a browser preview with an element highlighted and the generated locator displayed in the panel.

### 6. Go-To Navigation
**Title:** Jump to keyword definitions instantly
**Capture:** A .robot file with Ctrl+Click on a keyword showing navigation to its definition in another file, with the declaration highlighted.

### 7. Code Inspections
**Title:** Detect problems before running tests
**Capture:** A .robot file showing multiple inspection warnings: an undefined keyword with red underline, an empty test case with a warning icon, and a quick-fix popup.

### 8. Structure View
**Title:** Browse your test structure at a glance
**Capture:** The Structure tool window showing a tree of test cases, keywords, and variables alongside the editor with a .robot file open.

## Video Demo Outline (50 seconds)

| Time | Scene | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| 0-5s | Intro | Show plugin name and tagline over IDE with a .robot file open |
| 5-15s | Editing | Type a test case showing code completion, syntax highlighting, and parameter hints |
| 15-22s | Navigation | Ctrl+Click on a keyword to jump to its definition, then Find Usages |
| 22-32s | Debugging | Set a breakpoint, run debug, step through keywords, inspect variables |
| 32-40s | REPL | Open the REPL, type a keyword, show instant output |
| 40-48s | Inspector | Open Web Inspector, select an element, show generated locator |
| 48-50s | CTA | "Install Robot Framework Professional from JetBrains Marketplace" |
